definition: First post-cutoff announcement or filing of capacity investment at least 2% of latest annual revenue, or an explicitly material new facility, line or geography programme not already announced.
commercial_use: Anticipate capital, supplier, recruitment and execution demand.

definition: First explicit material restructuring, site closure or consolidation, redundancy programme or group cost programme after cutoff; routine continuous improvement excluded.
commercial_use: Anticipate intervention, advisory, technology and workforce demand.

definition: The company explicitly states expected profit or results are materially below its prior guidance or market expectation.
Adjusted operating margin falls at least 150 basis points year-on-year in the first comparable result whose period ends after cutoff.
commercial_use: Objective operating-performance target and financial baseline.

definition: Previously unannounced appointment or departure of a COO, divisional operations head, supply-chain or quality leader, CIO, CDO or transformation executive.
commercial_use: Indicates intervention, succession or capability build.
